## Overview
Centralized Identity Provider (IdP) microservice built with **Clean Architecture**.

Supports:
- **Email/Password** authentication
- **Social Login** (Google, Apple, Facebook, GitHub)
- **JWT RS256** tokens with JWKS endpoint
- **Refresh Token Rotation** with reuse detection
- **Token Blocklist** via Redis
- **RBAC** (Role-Based Access Control)

## Authentication
All protected endpoints require a Bearer token in the Authorization header:
```
Authorization: Bearer <access_token>
```

## Token Strategy
- **Access Token**: JWT RS256, 15-minute TTL
- **Refresh Token**: Opaque token, 7-day TTL with rotation
- **JWKS**: Public key available at `/authentication_api/api/v1/auth/.well-known/jwks.json`

post.description: Creates a new user account with email and password. Validates password complexity. Sends a verification email automatically.

password.description: Password (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit, special char)

emailVerified.description: False until the user confirms their email

post.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns JWT access token + refresh token. Requires email verification. Includes brute force protection (5 attempts / 15 min).

post.summary: Login with social provider (Google, Apple, etc.)
post.description: Validates the social provider token, finds or creates the user, and returns internal JWT tokens. The social token is discarded after validation.

token.description: ID token or access token from the social provider

isNewUser.description: True if the user was auto-registered

post.description: Confirms the user email address using the token received by email. Must be called before user can log in.
Requests a new verification email without exposing whether the address has a pending account. Rate limited by IP and e-mail cooldown.

email.description: E-mail address associated with the pending verification

post.description: Sends a password reset email to the given address. Always returns success to prevent user enumeration. Token expires in 1 hour.

email.description: Email address of the account to recover

post.description: Resets the user password using the token received by email. Revokes all active sessions for security.

token.description: Password reset token received by email

put.description: Changes the password for the authenticated user. Requires current password for confirmation. New password must meet complexity requirements and differ from current.

post.description: Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access token + refresh token pair. Implements token rotation: the old refresh token is invalidated.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token to exchange for a new pair

post.description: Adds the access token JTI to the Redis blocklist and revokes the refresh token. Requires Bearer token in Authorization header.
Used by the API Gateway or other microservices to validate an access token. Checks signature, expiration, and Redis blocklist.

get.description: Public endpoint that exposes the RS256 public key for JWT verification. Other microservices can use this to verify tokens without shared secrets.
Returns the profile of the authenticated user.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user email has been verified

get.description: Returns a paginated list of users. Supports filtering by role, status, and search by name/email.
Returns user details by ID. Admins can view any user; regular users can only view themselves.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user email has been verified

put.description: Updates user profile. Users can update their own profile; admins can update any user and change roles.

emailVerified.description: Whether the user email has been verified

delete.description: Sets user status to INACTIVE and revokes all refresh tokens. Users can deactivate themselves; admins can deactivate any user.

post.summary: Register a new client application (Admin only)
post.description: Registers a third-party application that can use this IdP. Returns clientId and clientSecret (secret shown only once).

get.description: Returns all registered client applications. Client secrets are not included.
